# poe.ninja PoE1 variant-unique registry (harvested)

**Generated by `research/probe_variants.py`** from LIVE poe.ninja PoE1 economy
overviews. Do not hand-edit -- re-run the probe to refresh (raw dumps in
`research/data/ninja_uniques_*.json` are the primary source of every number here).

- **League:** `Allflame`  |  **Harvested:** 2026-07-27 19:02 Central Daylight Time
- **Endpoint:** `GET https://poe.ninja/poe1/api/economy/stash/current/item/overview?league=Allflame&type=<Unique*>`
- **Provenance:** every price / variant string / link count below is
  **[OBSERVED]** in the dumped poe.ninja response. The *classification* and the
  *spread ratios* are **[DERIVED]** by this script's method (section 0). The
  `Foulborn` and timeless-jewel *interpretations* are **[INFERRED]** and flagged.
  No wiki/community claim is used anywhere in this file.

## 0. What this is + method

poe.ninja lists a unique once per **priced variation**. THREE independent axes drive
that variation; this file keeps them separate exactly as D-0019 requires (the task
asked for the first two -- the third, `base`, is the same problem and is included):

- **mod-variant** (sec 2) = a distinct value of the line's `variant` field (Impresence's
  `Chaos` vs `Fire`; Voices' `3 passives`; Doryani's Invitation's `Physical`). Null
  `variant` = poe.ninja gives the item only one priced form (see the sec 5 caveat).
- **base-variant** (sec 3) = the same unique NAME dropping on several `baseType`s
  (Precursor's Emblem on 5 ring bases; Combat Focus / Grand Spectrum on 3 jewel
  colours). Each base is effectively a different item; `variant` is usually null.
- **links-variant** (sec 4) = a distinct value of the `links` field (5L / 6L vs
  unlinked). Present only on weapons + body armours; null for jewels/rings/amulets/
  flasks/maps/relics/tinctures.

For each item NAME I group all its lines and compute **isolated** spread ratios
(dearest priced form / cheapest), so one axis never inflates another:

- **variantx** = spread across `variant` values **at a fixed link count** (widest over
  the link counts present) -- proves "pick the wrong variant -> wrong price".
- **basex** = spread across `baseType`s (best price per base).
- **linksx** = spread across `links` values **at a fixed variant** -- the 5L/6L gap.

A name is a **variant-unique** (needs a defining filter, per D-0019) when it has >=1
non-null `variant`, >=2 bases, or >=2 link counts; it is **price-variant-sensitive**
when the matching `x` ratio > 1. All chaos values are poe.ninja `chaosValue`
(already chaos; economy.md).

> **The sec 5 blind spot (most important for D-0019):** a non-null `variant` is
> SUFFICIENT to flag a variant-unique but NOT NECESSARY. The costliest-to-misprice
> uniques -- **Watcher's Eye, Forbidden Flame/Flesh, the 5 timeless jewels** -- carry
> a **null** `variant` because their value is a rolled MOD/SEED poe.ninja cannot
> enumerate, so it lists ONE floor line (with huge listing counts). The registry can
> NOT be built from this harvest's variant enumeration alone; those items are curated
> in sec 5 and must be priced via trade using the build's own copy.

## 2. Mod-variant uniques -- the registry core (101 names)

Every name with >=2 distinct `variant` values, **sorted by `variantx` (price
sensitivity = dearest variant / cheapest, links held fixed)**. These are the items
whose build-copy defining mod MUST drive the search (D-0019). `+L` = links **also**
vary (see sec 4). Split into the DURABLE registry (2a) and the league-transient
`Foulborn` copies (2b, see sec 6) so the stable list is not buried by league noise.

## 5. The blind spot -- floor-priced mod/seed-defined uniques (D-0019 core)

The uniques that are **most dangerous to price by name** carry a **null `variant`**
on poe.ninja, so sec 2 cannot surface them. Their value is a rolled MOD or SEED that
poe.ninja does not enumerate -- it lists ONE line, whose price is a **floor over a
heterogeneous bucket**. The data fingerprint is a **null-variant line with a huge
`listingCount`** (thousands of different real items dumped into one price).

**5a. Curated known mod/seed-defined uniques** -- membership is **[INFERRED -- domain
knowledge]**; every number is **[OBSERVED]** in the dump. These MUST be priced via
trade with the build copy's own defining mod/seed, never from the overview:

| Item | Type | Base | ninja `variant` | ninja floor chaos | listings | Real price driver [INFERRED] |
|---|---|---|---|--:|--:|---|
| Watcher's Eye | U.Jewel | Prismatic Jewel | null (single line) | 50c | 11,320 | which per-aura mod combo (2-3 rolled mods) it has |
| Forbidden Flame | U.Jewel | Crimson Jewel | null (single line) | 20c | 1,108 | which ascendancy notable it Allocates (must pair-match the Flesh) |
| Forbidden Flesh | U.Jewel | Cobalt Jewel | null (single line) | 30c | 863 | which ascendancy notable it Allocates (must pair-match the Flame) |
| Glorious Vanity | U.Jewel | Timeless Jewel | null (single line) | 30c | 9,766 | seed (Vaal era) -> exact keystone/notable transforms in radius |
| Lethal Pride | U.Jewel | Timeless Jewel | null (single line) | 68c | 6,189 | seed (Karui) -> added notables + attributes in radius |
| Brutal Restraint | U.Jewel | Timeless Jewel | null (single line) | 26c | 7,342 | seed (Maraketh) -> added notables + dexterity in radius |
| Militant Faith | U.Jewel | Timeless Jewel | null (single line) | 11c | 8,657 | seed (Templar) -> keystone granted + notable transforms |
| Elegant Hubris | U.Jewel | Timeless Jewel | null (single line) | 121c | 7,009 | seed (Eternal) -> added notables + small-passive effects |
| Thread of Hope | U.Jewel | Crimson Jewel | null (single line) | 22c | 557 | ring size (Small..Massive) = which distant passives it can allocate |
| Impossible Escape | U.Jewel | Viridian Jewel | null (single line) | 5.00c | 957 | which keystone it lets you reach past unallocated passives |
| Sublime Vision | U.Jewel | Prismatic Jewel | null (single line) | 136c | 137 | which single aura's empowering mod it grants |
| Split Personality | U.Jewel | Crimson Jewel | null (single line) | 2.00c | 1,453 | the two random attribute/defence mods it gains as it levels |

The 5 timeless jewels above make the point sharpest: poe.ninja does not even bucket
them by conqueror -- **one null-variant line each** (e.g. Militant Faith ~11c across 8,657 listings).
A timeless jewel's worth is its **seed** (which historic conqueror + which exact
notable transforms/keystone land in its socket radius); two same-name jewels with
different seeds are different items. D-0019's plan -- search timeless jewels by
**exact seed (min=max) + keystone**, and Forbidden Flame/Flesh by the **Allocates
<notable>** mod, and Watcher's Eye by its **rolled aura mods** -- is the only faithful
path; the overview supplies only a sanity floor. The build's own copy carries the
seed/mod, so the registry reads it from the character JSON, never from this table.
